resources.string: Paste the launch URL dsh-launch or dsh-url.sh printed — the Tailscale .ts.net address ending in ?token=… The app signs in itself and keeps the session for 30 days. It then serves the harness to this screen from the phone\'s own loopback, which is what lets your settings stick.
Could not load that address. Check the URL and that Tailscale is connected.
The harness did not accept that launch URL. Copy the current one from dsh-url.sh (or dsh-launch) and paste it again; each is good only until the harness restarts.
Photo access is needed to attach images. Allow it in Settings to attach from gallery.
The harness wants a sign-in. Copy the ?token=… launch URL printed by dsh-launch (or dsh-launch.ps1) and paste it above; it is the only copy, by design.
The web content keeps failing to start (likely low memory). It will reload on the next attempt — check the harness is still running.
